{"id":2015091092,"question_id":3408,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 month, 3 weeks","timestamp":1779941457,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"4 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/2015091092/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Count the Number of Special Characters I","memory":"9.4 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int numberOfSpecialChars(string word) {\n        unordered_set<char>st;\n\n        for(auto it : word) st.insert(it);\n\n        int count = 0;\n        for(auto it : word)\n        {\n            if(it >= 'A' and it <= 'Z') continue;\n            else if(st.count(toupper(it))) \n            {\n                count++;\n                st.erase(toupper(it));\n            }\n        }\n        return count;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"count-the-number-of-special-characters-i","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":2033}
